description: Fetch a verified contract from Etherscan (V2, one key for supported chains), audit it with kritisi, and return findings with an optional report. reportPath ending in .md/.markdown writes Markdown, .pdf writes PDF. Requires ETHERSCAN_API_KEY in the server environment; API keys are never tool arguments. Verified source only; proxies are resolved to their implementation.

chainId.description: EVM chain ID, for example 1 for Ethereum or 42161 for Arbitrum

includeReport.description: Include the full findings JSON in the response (omitted by default to keep context small)

outputPdf.description: Legacy PDF output path; prefer reportPath

reportPath.description: Write a report to this path; .pdf, .md, or .markdown selects the format

name: audit_contract
title: Audit a deployed contract
